tagline: Huang returns and markets jump; Iran says Hormuz tankers mined; Ukraine hits two Russian refineries

figures.label: Ukrainian drones Russia says it downed
tankers Iran says hit Hormuz mines
lashes given to singer in Qom
Democratic seats in the next House

stories.headline: Huang returns and stocks surge
stories.dek: Huang's return lifted Nvidia over 31% and about $1 trillion; the Nasdaq closed up 6.5% at 24,090.
stories.scene: A Wall Street board with the Nasdaq at 24,090, a green 6.5% arrow, and a CEO nameplate set back on a chipmaker's desk

stories.headline: Drones hit two Russian refineries
stories.dek: Ukraine struck Perm, killing one, and Novoshakhtinsk, which then halted; Russia said it downed 192 drones.
stories.scene: Night flames on refinery towers in snow, a stopped plant gate, and a tally of 192 intercepted drones

stories.headline: Iran says Hormuz tankers mined
stories.dek: Iran's navy said three tankers hit mines and burned; Tehran vowed all means against the blockade.
stories.scene: Three burning oil tankers in a narrow strait, floating mines, and a line of blockading warships

stories.headline: Britain recognises Rohingya genocide
stories.dek: Miliband sanctioned five Myanmar generals and pledged a law to stop aviation-fuel sales.
stories.scene: A Foreign Office lectern, five sanction folders, and a draft bill blocking aviation fuel

stories.headline: Car bomb rocks Villavicencio offices
stories.dek: A car bomb by the Meta government building hurt dozens, including five guards; no deaths were reported.
stories.scene: A burnt car chassis before a shattered government facade, five guard helmets, ambulances, no bodies

stories.headline: Israeli strike kills UNRWA worker
stories.dek: At least four Palestinians were killed Monday, including UNRWA worker Adel Al-Helo near a well.
stories.scene: A damaged water well, an UNRWA vest, and four covered stretchers in northern Gaza

stories.headline: Houthis report deadly Saudi strikes
stories.dek: Houthis said Hodeida telecom strikes killed 17 workers and wounded 11; Saba later put Lahj at 25.
stories.scene: A smoking Red Sea telecom building and burnt buses in a wadi, with rescue crews

stories.headline: Singer lashed 74 times in Qom
stories.dek: Lawyers said Parastoo Ahmadi and four male colleagues each received 74 lashes for a hijab-free concert.
stories.scene: A closed sentence-enforcement office in Qom, a microphone, and a discarded scarf, with no graphic of the lashing

stories.headline: Spain ends Puigdemont exile case
stories.dek: The Supreme Court shelved the last case against Carles Puigdemont, clearing a return after nearly nine years.
stories.scene: An empty defendant's chair, a closed case file, and a Brussels-to-Barcelona boarding pass

stories.headline: FIFA names 2031 and 2035 hosts
stories.dek: The US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will host the 2031 Women's World Cup; a UK bid takes 2035.
stories.scene: A women's match ball, four Americas flags marked 2031, and UK flags marked 2035, with 48-team badges

stories.headline: FBI probes crime-database breach
stories.dek: The FBI is investigating an apparent second recent breach of the National Crime Information Center.
stories.scene: A dark server rack labelled NCIC, an FBI badge, and a red breach light

stories.headline: US blacklists chip firm Megaspeed
stories.dek: Commerce restricted Singapore's Megaspeed from buying advanced chips; the firm denies diverting them to China.
stories.scene: A Singapore data-centre aisle sealed with a US export-control stamp and crates of AI chips

stories.headline: Democrats reach 259 House seats
stories.dek: Chuck Hubbard narrowly beat Virginia Foxx in North Carolina, leaving three House races still uncalled.
stories.scene: A House seating chart with 259 blue seats and three seats left blank

stories.headline: Drone hits Cucuta police station
stories.dek: Three people were hurt and more than 60 homes damaged in the city's first reported drone attack.
stories.scene: A police compound with a small blast scar and rows of cracked houses about 20 metres away

stories.headline: Awami League clash injures 30
stories.dek: Rival banned-party factions in Gopalganj set off four crude bombs and vandalised 12 shops.
stories.scene: A town street with shattered flower shops and fragments of four crude bombs

stories.headline: BNP factions fight in Jhenaidah
stories.dek: Fifteen people were hurt and 28 houses and shops wrecked as two BNP factions fought on Monday.
stories.scene: Damaged village houses in Shailkupa and a clinic treating bandaged men

stories.headline: Stone truck kills seven in Punjab
stories.dek: A truck loaded with stones overturned onto a parked minitruck near Bahawalpur, killing seven and injuring two.
stories.scene: An overturned stone truck on a crushed minitruck, with an excavator lifting wreckage

stories.headline: Deep magnitude 6.5 off Vanuatu
stories.dek: A magnitude 6.5 quake struck at 598 kilometres depth; a 4.9 followed, with no damage reported.
stories.scene: A Pacific map with a deep-focus star at 598 km and a green no-damage marker

stories.headline: Tajikistan starts leaving the ICC
stories.dek: Tajikistan began formal withdrawal from the International Criminal Court, the fourth exit since a US push.
stories.scene: An ICC flag being lowered outside a government building in Dushanbe

stories.headline: Turkey says PKK left 14 bases
stories.dek: Turkish intelligence said the PKK had withdrawn from 14 more bases in northern Iraq under disarmament talks.
stories.scene: Empty mountain outposts in northern Iraq with abandoned sandbags

stories.headline: Bomb threats hit hundreds of schools
stories.dek: Hundreds of schools in Denmark and Germany got emailed bomb threats; police said classes should continue.
stories.scene: A full schoolyard beside a police screen showing a bomb-threat email

stories.headline: Quebec legislators must swear to king
stories.dek: Quebec's Superior Court suspended a 2022 law and again required an oath to King Charles III.
stories.scene: The National Assembly chamber, an oath card, and a portrait of King Charles III

stories.headline: Hunger-striking student dies in Rome
stories.dek: A 58-year-old student died at Sapienza University during a hunger strike over a missing housing place.
stories.scene: A student tent outside Sapienza with a candle and a blank housing assignment

stories.headline: Democrats schedule 12 primary debates
stories.dek: The DNC set 12 debates from June 2027 into early 2028 and capped each stage at 20 candidates.
stories.scene: An empty debate stage with 12 date cards and a dark-money pledge on the podium

stories.headline: Dymer toll rises after Sunday strike
stories.dek: Moscow Times said rescuers found another body, taking Sunday's Dymer strike toll to 11.
stories.scene: A partly collapsed five-storey block with rescuers and a newly recovered body bag

stories.headline: Iowa blast shifted to Wednesday
stories.dek: An appeals court let the Army detonate five tons of lead azide; Trump still wants the governor-elect's assent.
stories.scene: Sixty-eight sealed barrels at an Iowa munitions plant, a court stamp, and a wind map

stories.headline: Rep. Gomez to resign 1 December
stories.dek: House Ethics found substantial evidence of sexual misconduct with a staffer; Gomez disputed it but will quit.
stories.scene: A House Ethics report and a resignation letter dated 1 December

stories.headline: Watchdog faults ICE hiring shortcuts
stories.dek: A DHS draft called shortened training a catastrophic failure, with nearly 6,000 officers done in 10 days.
stories.scene: A half-empty training room, laptops showing a 10-day course, and an inspector-general folder

stories.headline: NATO answers nuclear-satellite reports
stories.dek: German media said Russia may orbit a nuclear-armed satellite within 60 days; Rutte pledged to defend space.
stories.scene: A NATO radar aircraft and a satellite icon with a question mark, not a launched weapon

stories.headline: Pelicot condemns nude promo photos
stories.dek: Gisele Pelicot said she will sue after a publisher sent nude photos of her to promote a book.
stories.scene: A book jacket, a fully redacted photo print, and a legal letter, with no nudity shown

stories.headline: US suspects tanker cyberattacks
stories.dek: The Wall Street Journal said investigators suspect Iran in cyber hits on as many as 50 ships.
stories.scene: A tanker bridge with dark screens and a cyber alert, not an explosion

stories.headline: Tatarstan pump station reportedly burns
stories.dek: Monitors said a Tatarstan pumping station burned in the drone wave; Kyiv Independent could not verify it.
stories.scene: A distant oil pumping station with an unverified smoke column and a question mark

stories.headline: Qatar premier meets Marco Rubio
stories.dek: Qatar's prime minister met Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington, his second visit in weeks.
stories.scene: Two flags, Qatar and the United States, outside the State Department during a mediation visit

stories.headline: Treasury sanctions Iran shadow banks
stories.dek: Treasury sanctioned about two dozen Iranian people and firms, including nine individuals, over shadow banking.
stories.scene: A Treasury sanctions list with Tehran and Dubai company names crossed by a stamp

stories.headline: Yemen government claims 647 strikes
stories.dek: The anti-Houthi government said its coalition hit 647 targets and blamed Houthis for killing two in Taiz.
stories.scene: A coalition strike map across Yemen and a village marker in Taiz counting two dead

stories.headline: Iran claims $290 billion from US
stories.dek: A judiciary official said domestic courts awarded $290 billion, and state TV said US-linked ships were seized.
stories.scene: A Tehran courtroom claim for $290 billion and seized commercial ships at a dock

stories.headline: Eisenkot sees no immediate Iran threat
stories.dek: Gadi Eisenkot said Israel need not strike Iran before a government forms; Netanyahu warned of grave threats.
stories.scene: Two lecterns in Jerusalem, one saying no immediate strike and one warning of grave threats

stories.headline: Araghchi says land blockade impossible
stories.dek: Iran's foreign minister said a land blockade cannot work and resisting sanctions is a national duty.
stories.scene: Abbas Araghchi at a podium with a map showing open land borders around a sea blockade

stories.headline: Australia backs Rohingya genocide ruling
stories.dek: BBC said Australia joined Britain, Canada, Belgium, Portugal and Spain in accepting the ICJ genocide finding.
stories.scene: Parliament House in Canberra with an ICJ judgment and the Australian flag

date_check.event: COP31 closed in Antalya with no agreement
date_check.note: UN page: closed 22 November without consensus. The draft did not mention fossil fuels and was not gavelled. Not a Monday decision.

date_check.event: Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix
date_check.note: SBS bulletin timestamped 22 Nov 19:30 UTC. Norris second, Piastri third from 17th. Standings: Antonelli 402, Verstappen 304, Hamilton 267.

date_check.event: Alcaraz beats Zverev in the ATP Finals
date_check.note: Wikipedia portal 22 Nov, citing Reuters dated 22 Nov: 6-2, 7-6 (9-7).
Report dated 22 Nov: Spurs 114-91, Wembanyama 50 points, 18 rebounds, 5 blocks, 4 steals. A Monday scratch was not opened.

date_check.event: Russian corvette Merkury sinks at Benghazi
date_check.note: Wikipedia portal 22 Nov: naval drones, ship capsizes, several killed and at least 10 hurt. Monday coverage is follow-up.

date_check.event: About 12,000 evacuated at Manchester's Co-op Live
date_check.note: Wikipedia portal 22 Nov: unknown substance, first thought to be tear gas, during a Don Toliver concert.
The strike was Sunday. Monday's new fact is the toll rising to 11, kept as story 25.
The 1956 Games opened on 22 November. No Monday ceremony was found.
Democracy Now: Sunday weight-and-balance outage, not a Monday failure.
Wikipedia portal 21 Nov: at least 24 killed, 30 missing, five hurt. A Reuters page dated 23 Nov returned 401, so no Monday toll was confirmed.

date_check.event: Drone sets a Russian cargo ship on fire in the Gulf of Finland
date_check.note: Wikipedia portal 21 Nov. The name Sparta II was not on that page.
Wikipedia portal 21 Nov: four soldiers and 16 gunmen killed. The arrest itself is on the Friday portal.

date_check.event: Arrest of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores
date_check.note: Wikipedia portal 20 Nov. The AFP/France 24 story is dated 21 Nov. This is the 'El Chapo Isidro' capture.
Wikipedia portal 20 Nov: 24 killed and 24 rescued.
Magnitude 6.7 on Friday 20 Nov near Junin; one truck driver killed. A Monday Rio Times piece was a follow-up, not a new quake.
CBS: Friday's sell-off put the S&P 500 and Dow in correction; 20 Nov was the Nasdaq's second-worst day of 2026.

date_check.event: Mamdani unveils a Rikers closure plan
date_check.note: Democracy Now: plan announced Friday, close the jail by 2032, replace it with four borough jails.
Democracy Now: released Friday. The US still seeks extradition.
The ruling predates Monday. Monday's news is Britain's sanctions and recognition.
Still on Democracy Now's popular list. Not re-reported as a 23 November event in the pages opened. The brief dates it 19 Nov.

date_check.event: Earlier Hormuz ship strikes and Gaza deaths
date_check.note: Democracy Now: three ships struck over the weekend, separate from Monday's mine claim. Gaza's Saturday and Sunday deaths are not Monday's four.
Democracy Now: father and daughter arrested Saturday. Not a Monday arrest.
